notes.title: August 2024: An Update
notes.notes:
participants. 

checking in to say Silkbulb Test is still very much in development, despite the radio silence. 

life comes at you fast it seems, arguably too fast. i blink and months have passed in its wake. but progress is progress and im happy with where its at and where its going. 

i have no estimates or reassurances other than that im working on it all day, every day. i want to make something special - something worthy of your time.  time is nonrefundable and precious and id prefer not to waste it - mine or yours. 

keep your head to horizon and look for me one day soon. 

<3 tim

notes.title: SILKBULB FLATHEAD RELEASE
notes.notes:
Silkbulb Test is taking frickin forever. And I know ya'll are waiting to get traumatized by it. 

So as a brief respite from the wait - Im releasing a small game called, "flathead"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840480/silkbulb__flathead/

that is the link. its a spooky&short single player game.

The full name is 'silkbulb / flathead' because i wanted it to be clear theyre related and Im a simple man. 

Think of it like a short film to the full length SBT. Itll be like 1-2 bucks and itll both be a frickin good time and itll help support me so I can both keep eating and living while I make the full length game. 


That last part is important. Ill level with all of ya -  I am QUICKLY running out of money - and as someone who doesn't like kickstarters and generally asking for money - I want this to be a way for you to support the making of the silkbulb test by having something tangible to buy and play. 

Dont get me wrong, Ive spent way too much time on this and itll be a hella good time (im using 'hella' now) - but if you wanna play SBT, help me help you help me get there. 




TL;DR: im releasing a small game in late march/early April. wishlists are super important - so if ya interested, please wishlist it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840480/silkbulb__flathead/
